title: orbitopt Flight Lab mission config v1.0
description: A user-editable YAML/JSON config that runs a Flight Lab segment (flightlab.simulate: 3-DOF ascent + optional FL-304 recovery + tudatpy orbit re-fly) through the unified mission pipeline (M-03, task #221). The flight is one candidate on the pipeline's search stage, its Gate-B verdict is the verify stage, the scene comes from the FL-005 run importer and the verification report from orbitopt.flightlab.segment.flight_run_report -- same pipeline-result / verification-report documents as every other kind. Like the other mission schemas this one is deliberately strict (additionalProperties: false everywhere); every section besides `mission`, `flightlab` and `output` is absent by design, and every optional flightlab field falls back to the orbitopt.flightlab.simulate.simulate default.

schemaVersion.description: Which version of this mission-config schema the document was written against.

id.description: Stable slug for the produced scene, e.g. 'leo-two-stage-pipeline'.

flightlab.description: What to fly and how. Paths resolve as given (absolute or CWD-relative), then against the packaged flightlab data root.

target_file.description: FlightTarget v1 YAML/JSON (flight-target-1.0.json) to fly, e.g. 'scenarios/leo_two_stage.yaml'.

vehicle_file.description: Vehicle file to fly. Omitted: resolve the target's declared vehicle.source with the same 4-step order `orbitopt flight simulate` uses.

run_dir.description: Where the FlightResult run directory is written. Default: next to the scene as <scene stem>.flightrun.

refly.description: Independent tudatpy re-fly of the insertion orbit (sets physics_verified; false leaves it not-assessed, never passed).

timeout_s.description: Wall-clock bound on the OpenTsiolkovsky ascent subprocess.

run_recovery.description: Fly the FL-304 recovery chain when the target declares a recovery (recovery.kind != none).

recovery_options.description: FL-302/303 planner knobs passed through to the recovery pipeline (max_fevals, initial_guess, ...).

earth_texture.description: Scene rendering only (FL-005 importer): false renders Earth as a bare marker.

verification.description: Standard pipeline verification switch (what `orbitopt run --skip-verify` sets): with enabled=false the tudatpy orbit re-fly is skipped and physics_verified stays not-assessed, never passed.

scene_file.description: Where `orbitopt run` writes the produced scene-1.0.json document; overridable with --out.

verification_report.description: Where `orbitopt run` writes the machine-readable verification report (verification-report-1.0.json schema). Default: next to the scene as <scene stem>.verification.json.

pipeline_result.description: Where `orbitopt run` writes the standardized pipeline result (pipeline-result-1.0.json schema). Default: next to the scene as <scene stem>.pipeline.json.
